question: Select the shortcut key to get the copyright symbol in MS Word?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alt + Ctrl + C**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alt + Ctrl + C (Correct):**

 
 
• This is the keyboard shortcut specifically designed to insert the copyright symbol (©) in MS Word.
 
• Holding down the Alt key while pressing Ctrl and C together efficiently places the symbol at your cursor's location.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ctrl + C: **This shortcut is commonly used for copying selected text or objects in various applications, including MS Word. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**Additional Ways to Insert the Copyright Symbol:

 
• **Symbol Menu**: Navigate to the "**Insert**" tab and then click on "**Symbol**." This opens a window where you can browse through symbols and select the copyright symbol (©) by double-clicking it.
 
• **AutoCorrect**: You can set up AutoCorrect to automatically replace a specific text string with the copyright symbol. For example, typing "(c)" and then pressing the spacebar could be configured to convert to (©).
